textbookText: In vertical circular motion, the tension varies significantly with the position of the object in its path due to the addition of gravitational forces. The tension is typically minimized when the object is at the top of the circular path. The motion of a particle in a vertical circle has been outlined in fig 6.12. The particle sometimes lies at the lowest point C and sometimes at the highest point A. Roller Coaster rides and Ferris wheel are two examples of motion in a vertical circle.

T = 3.875 × 0.32 = 1.24m 6.7 Application of Centripetal Force The application of centripetal force mainly focuses on the automobiles while making a turn, the turn is an arc of a circular path and the friction on the wheels provides the necessary centripetal force to balance the motion. 6.8.1 Motion of a car on a level curved path While taking the round, the tires of the car tend to leave road and move away from the centre of the curve. Let a vehicle be undergoing a horizontal curved track of radius r. In the motion of the car, frictional force on the tires provides the necessary centripetal force, and lack of it will cause it to be thrown outside.
